title: Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ Fresh Mint 10ml E-Liquid
description: Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ Fresh Mint delivers a clean and refreshing burst of cool Mint flavour. Crisp and bright, and with a pleasantly sweet flavour, this e-liquid offers a pure Mint experience with a cool exhale that leaves a fresh sensation making it an ideal all-day vape for mint or menthol fans. Designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping, this nicotine salt e-liquid ensures a consistently satisfying throat hit with optimised nicotine absorption. The 50/50 VG/PG ratio enhances flavour clarity while keeping vapour production discreet, making it ideal for pod kits and vape starter kits. Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ e-liquids provide a cost-effective and sustainable alternative to single-use disposable vapes, offering popular flavours in a refillable format. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, each bottle features a childproof cap and an easy-fill nozzle for convenience.
